routeFindings.summary: /dashboard/creator remains the Creator Dashboard landing surface.
The landing CTA no longer points at /dashboard/drops, which is not present in this repo.
Because no creator create-drop route exists, the CTA is labeled Manage drops and routes to the existing library surface.

mobileFindings.summary: Creator Dashboard landing exposes compact_v2 density, human error language, and route-state markers.
Creator stats render inside one compact Creator Overview module instead of standalone metric cards.
Quick Broadcast is lower priority on mobile while creator stats are unavailable.
Landing route has top spacing plus bottom-nav/report-issue safe padding.

errorFindings.summary: Module warnings render human fallback copy and settings load failures use HumanErrorNotice.
